name: Campus thresholds

typography.body: Segoe UI Variable, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif
typography.display: Iowan Old Style, Palatino Linotype, Georgia, serif

principles: Use labeled campus wayfinding for request progress, not geographic maps.
Reserve evergreen for primary actions and active navigation.
Use copper and brass as restrained wayfinding accents.
Keep each role workflow and its existing data behavior intact.
Respect keyboard focus, reduced motion, and small-screen use.
